claim: The 1.5x top-8 edit shares RL's route re-ranking, so on fresh2026 problems where edit, RL and cued base all fail, the edit's wrong answers are closer to RL's than the base's are after normalizing each model's own concentration (D_fresh in [0.08, 0.6]).
The edit has no route preference beyond fewer slips, so its normalized wrong-answer agreement with RL on fresh2026 is no higher than the cued base's (D_fresh in [-0.10, 0.07]).
